lead_fa: Fire بازی برست و کلید-واکنشی است: بیشتر آسیب تو در پنجرهٔ [[Combustion]] می‌آید که در آن همهٔ کست‌ها Crit می‌شوند و با Mastery: Ignite شعله به اهداف نزدیک می‌پرد. دو مسیر Hero Tree داری: [[Sunfury]] با Spellfire Sphere و ققنوس Arcane و [[Frostfire]] با Frostfire Bolt و Isothermic Core.

strengths: Higher damage at high-health targets and during execute phases
Fun reactive gameplay; satisfying Combustion cooldown
Cleave via Mastery: Ignite without sacrificing single-target damage
Great mobility: Shimmer, Alter Time, Hot Streak!, Scorch
weaknesses: No spread cleave when targets are separated
Very little passive damage reduction and no reactive self-healing
Quick fingers are required during cooldowns

hero.recommendation: Both trees are viable; Fire's damage is Combustion-driven either way.
hero.sunfury: Generates Spellfire Spheres and summons Arcane Phoenixes to consume them; calls down Meteorite storms via Glorious Incandescence.
hero.frostfire: Fuses Fire and Frost with Frostfire Bolt; Isothermic Core makes Meteor necessary; many passive damage increases and minor spell improvements.

builds.codes_source: Wowhead 'Best Fire Mage Talent Builds' page (wowhead.com/guide/classes/mage/fire/talent-builds-pve-dps), export strings captured verbatim via the page's Copy buttons on 2026-10-27; do not modify.

concepts: Convert and spend Hot Streak: critical strikes generate Heating Up then Hot Streak!; spend it on instant Pyroblast.
Combustion makes every cast critically strike: alternate Pyroblast (Hot Streak!) with builders.
Mastery: Ignite spreads fire damage from your main target to nearby enemies for free cleave.

combustion_priority: Meteor if it will land during Combustion
Pyroblast again if you just spent Hot Streak! at the end of a Scorch or Pyroblast hard-cast
Fire Blast to generate Hot Streak!
outside_combustion: Set up Combustion when it will be ready soon: with Pyroclasm, hard-cast Pyroblast and press Combustion right before the cast ends; without Pyroclasm, cast Meteor to get Pyroclasm for that setup; otherwise begin Scorch or Fireball and press Combustion right before the cast ends
Instant Pyroblast with Hot Streak! or Hyperthermia
Meteor if your next Combustion is ~30 seconds away
Fire Blast with Heating Up while casting Fireball (or Pyroblast)
Fire Blast after spending Hot Streak! when a crit is guaranteed
rotation.opener_note: Open into the Combustion setup described above; the fight starts with the Pyroclasm hard-cast into Combustion window when possible.

gear.gearing_rules: Item level matters but stats matter a lot for Fire: low-ilvl jewelry with good stats can beat higher pieces. Many best items come from raid. Crit-heavy stat priority; sim with Raidbots.

tier_set.name: Primal Leywarden's Attire
tier_set.pc2: Pyroclasm causes Flamestrike and Pyroblast to always critically strike.
tier_set.pc4: Pyroclasm reduces the cast time of Flamestrike and Pyroblast by 20% and its damage bonus is increased by 25%.
tier_set.note: Spend procs on hard-cast Pyroblasts that hit really hard; the proc rate is random but can be forced with Sunfury's Sunfury Execution.

mplus.hero_note: Sunfury carries the raid/M+ tags; Frostfire is the Delves pick.
tips: Ignite cleaves only when targets are close: line packs up for Combustion windows.
Living Bomb spreads fire between packs; Flamestrike covers gathered mobs.
Shimmer + Alter Time handle most dungeon mechanics while keeping casts up.
